taste:
Large Pepsi Max is a bold, intensely sweet cola with a crisp finish and lively carbonation. The bubbles give each sip a noticeable fizz, while the sharp cola flavour makes it more than a neutral drink alongside food. Although it contains no sugar, the taste is firmly on the sweet side, so it suits someone who wants sweetness rather than a restrained soft drink.

Served ice-cold over plenty of ice cubes, it has a refreshing character from the first sip. The large glass suits anyone wanting a substantial non-alcoholic drink. Alongside spicy meat feast pizza or a BBQ bacon burger, its sharpness acts as a palate cleanser between bites.
